entity.title: Candidate
entity.description: A person who applies to job positions. The name is the platform record; the e-mail is a linked contact channel; the resume link and the source of the candidate are kept in the module namespace. An existing person is reused instead of duplicated.

applications.title: Applications
applications.description: The applications this candidate has made to job positions.

emails.title: E-mail
emails.description: The candidate's e-mail address, a contact channel linked by HasContact.

positions.title: Positions applied to
positions.description: The job positions the candidate applied to, read through the applications.

capabilities.read.byId: Loads the candidate by id so the recruiter and the hiring manager see name, e-mail, resume link and source on an application.
capabilities.locate.byName: The recruiter searches candidates by name before registering, to reuse an existing one.
capabilities.locate.byContact: The recruiter finds an existing candidate by e-mail during registration, so the same person is not duplicated.
capabilities.locate.byDocument: When a national document is known, the recruiter finds the candidate by it to deduplicate.
capabilities.register.createOrAttach: The recruiter registers a candidate: the person is reused when found by document or e-mail, created otherwise, and tagged hiringPipeline.Candidate.
capabilities.edit.platformFields: The recruiter corrects the candidate's name, aliases or privacy consent.
capabilities.edit.moduleNamespace: The recruiter updates the candidate's resume link and source.
capabilities.link.contact: The recruiter records the candidate's e-mail as a contact channel linked with HasContact.
capabilities.listLinks: The candidate screen lists the candidate's e-mail and linked records.
capabilities.inactivate: The recruiter inactivates a candidate who should no longer be considered, keeping the history; it can be reactivated.
capabilities.attach.document: The recruiter stores a resume file or other document against the candidate when it is not a published link.
capabilities.comment: Recruiters and hiring managers leave notes about the candidate.
capabilities.tag: The recruiter labels candidates (for example by skill) inside the hiringPipeline namespace.
capabilities.statusHistory.read: Shows when the candidate record was inactivated or reactivated, and by whom.
capabilities.audit: Shows who changed the candidate's data and when.

id.description: mdmId; stable through promotion and merge.

version.description: Bumped by the engine on every write; optimistic concurrency.

details.description: The platform record of the person who applies to job positions, with the hiringPipeline namespace.

name.description: The candidate's name as the recruiter registers it; the name shown in application lists.
name.title: Full name

status.title: Record status
status.description: Whether the candidate record is in use; an inactive candidate is kept for history.

docType.title: Document type
docType.description: Type of national document, when the recruiter has it; used to avoid duplicate candidates.

docId.description: National document number of the candidate, when known; used for deduplication.
docId.title: Document number

countryCode.description: Country of the candidate, which decides the document and privacy rules that apply.
countryCode.title: Country

tags.description: Roles of the record; carries hiringPipeline.Candidate once registered.
tags.title: Module roles

createdAt.title: Registered at
createdAt.description: When the person record was created.

updatedAt.title: Updated at
updatedAt.description: When the person record was last changed.

identification.description: How the candidate is recognised and filtered across the organization.

aliases.description: Other names the candidate goes by, such as a maiden name or nickname, helping recruiters find an existing candidate.
aliases.title: Other names

contacts.description: Summary of the candidate's contact channels; the candidate's e-mail appears here once linked.
contacts.title: Contacts

relationshipRefs.description: Compact keys kept by the platform for the candidate's links, including contacts.
relationshipRefs.title: Relationship keys

base.description: What every record has, whatever its subtype.

privacyConsent.description: The candidate's consent to having personal data processed, required for residents of Brazil and the EU.
privacyConsent.title: Privacy consent

person.description: Natural-person data of the platform; the hiring pipeline asks for none of it.

general.description: Fields promoted by the organization; read only by this module.

resumeLink.title: Resume link
resumeLink.description: Web address where the candidate's resume is published (for example an online profile or a shared document), as given at registration.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the candidate came from, as recorded by the recruiter.

hiringPipeline.description: What the hiring pipeline knows about the candidate and nobody else needs.
